id.description: Canonical NPM package URL when the package name is known; otherwise an assessment-scoped version key.

semverCompatibility.description: SemVer's API guarantee; it does not prove application compatibility.

AssessmentExposureReference.description: Identifies one CVE-linked reachable package version in a submitted source.

id.description: Stable source/package/CVE key, or source key while resolution is incomplete.

coverage.description: Counts refer only to the returned page. An unavailable dataset or an incomplete source means the full exposure count is unknown.

DataStatus.description: Bounded data-freshness information intended for browser users.

failureMessage.description: A stable, bounded message rather than upstream diagnostic output.

HealthDiagnostics.description: Health information for operators, not untrusted API callers.

previousVersionedPackages.description:
The last successfully published reachable-version snapshot, if any.

A failed re-elaboration does not replace the prior snapshot, so callers can continue to inspect it while acting on `diagnostic`.

retryable.description: Whether the automatic-retry service would still retry a failure of this kind; does not by itself mean an automatic retry is scheduled, since the automatic-attempt budget may already be exhausted.

message.description: A fixed explanation that does not include untrusted registry content.
